title: Why I changed my mind about nuclear power | Michael Shellenberger | TEDxBerlin
summary: In this TEDxBerlin talk, environmental activist Michael Shellenberger explains why he changed from opposing nuclear power to advocating it, after looking at the evidence on Chernobyl, Fukushima and air pollution.
why: Frequently linked in nuclear-power threads as an eye-opening pro-nuclear argument from a former anti-nuclear activist.

quote.text: This is a self-professed anti-nuclear hippy giving a talk about how rationally looking at chernobyl and fukushima made him a nuclear power advocate.
